view_diplomacy_phase: render a Diplomacy game phase map as SVG and print filtered diplomatic messages
view_phase_with_message_filter: view a specific game phase and filter messages by sender or recipient power
color_power_string: return a colored bold terminal string for a Diplomacy power name like ENGLAND or FRANCE
render_current_phase: display the current phase map and all messages for the active Diplomacy game
view_historical_phase_messages: render a past phase map and print its diplomatic messages from the game history
